⚔️ Anime Frontier

🌌 The Frontier Awaits. Assemble Your Frontilier and Conquer the Battlefield!

Enter the world of Anime Frontier , where powerful anime warriors clash in thrilling lane-based battles! Build your dream Frontilier, discover new strategies, and push beyond your limits to claim victory!

🌟 Collect Powerful Warriors!
- Summon a variety of anime-inspired characters.
- Strengthen your units and unleash their true potential.
- Create powerful team combinations to overcome your enemies.

⚔️ Command the Battlefield!
- Deploy your warriors and stop incoming enemy forces.
- Experiment with different strategies and team setups.
- Face challenging stages filled with dangerous enemies and powerful bosses.

🔥 Your Adventure Starts Here!
- Explore exciting battles and challenging game modes.
- Join forces with friends and fight together.
- Build your ultimate Frontilier and conquer the Frontier!
